# Template: API Service

> Backend-only API projects.

## Questions

1. Framework? (FastAPI, Express, Django REST, Actix, Gin, etc.)
2. Database? (PostgreSQL, SQLite, MySQL, MongoDB, etc.)
3. Auth required? (JWT, OAuth, API keys, session, none)

## Generated Files

- `spec.md` — endpoints, auth, data models
- `architecture.md` — layered architecture (routes → services → db)
- `tech-stack.md` — framework, database driver, testing tools
- `environment.md` — venv, deps, dev server command
